references.comparison_role: Related logical active Detail contract only; not an independent orientation-return exact-state reference.

cases.comparison_role: Current closed Reader against its assigned retained processed artwork input; no independent exact-state design reference.
cases.observation: The full-height artwork is centered with narrow white side margins. The lined skyline panel, dotted panel, radial lower-left panel, crosshatched right panel and all three bar-mark bubbles remain visible. Their borders and bubble marks are also present in the opened processed input. No visible application footer, ribbon, page/status label, download notice or panel survives the close sequence.
cases.software_evidence: Frozen actions record menu, mode, panel close, then menu. Active state is Reader with menu false, empty reader panel and displayed page 12/40.
cases.accepted_scope: Visible pure artwork after the recorded software close sequence.
cases.software_limits: No page identity can be read from the bar-mark fixture. This image does not establish hidden footer behavior, native input, physical lifecycle or reader leases.
cases.owner_oracle_record: input.cases[0].owner_recorded_pure_reader_oracle; owner declares exact_match true and changed_pixels 0; no recomputation or oracle image opening.
cases.static_verdict: Visible source composition accepted within processed-input scope; raw-original identity and independent exact-state reference remain unqualified.

cases.comparison_role: Current closed Reader against the checkpoint's retained processed artwork input; no independent exact-state design reference.
cases.observation: The candidate preserves the opened checkpoint input's skyline, dotted and crosshatched fills, radial burst, black arch and bar-mark bubbles. The complete composition reaches both vertical viewport edges with matching narrow side margins. No visible application page count, footer, bookmark ribbon or status decoration is added.
cases.software_evidence: Frozen action seeks to 20. Active and displayed Reader state both report 20/40 with menu false and no panel. The recorded process uses the checkpoint data directory.
cases.accepted_scope: Visible pure artwork at the owner-recorded software checkpoint state.
cases.software_limits: The fixture artwork is visually the same pattern as the other closed-reader images; page 20 is supported by frozen state, not by readable page-specific artwork. No persistence execution was performed by this reviewer.
cases.owner_oracle_record: input.cases[1].owner_recorded_pure_reader_oracle; owner declares exact_match true and changed_pixels 0; not a substitute for these two actual opens.
cases.static_verdict: Visible checkpoint composition accepted within processed-input scope; raw-original identity and independent exact-state reference remain unqualified.

cases.comparison_role: Current restored closed Reader against its separately opened retained processed artwork path; no independent exact-state design reference.
cases.observation: The restored candidate keeps the entire opened source composition, including the upper skyline bars, two oval bubbles, rectangular bubble, panel gutters and bottom radial/arch shapes. No transient overlay, application footer, bookmark ribbon or page/status label is visible. The visible composition matches the checkpoint appearance inspected in this job.
cases.software_evidence: The frozen case command starts a fresh process with --resume and the checkpoint data directory, with no scripted actions. Its active route is Reader and both reader page fields are 20/40. Frozen metadata records a different process ID from the checkpoint.
cases.accepted_scope: Visible pure artwork and owner-recorded fresh-process software restoration to Reader page 20.
cases.software_limits: Static process/state records support software startup restoration only. The common fixture artwork cannot independently prove page-specific content, physical sleep/wake, framebuffer behavior, e-ink refresh or live-reader leases.
cases.owner_oracle_record: input.cases[2].owner_recorded_pure_reader_oracle; owner declares exact_match true and changed_pixels 0; no metric or runtime execution by this reviewer.
cases.static_verdict: Visible restored composition accepted within processed-input scope; raw-original identity and independent exact-state reference remain unqualified.

cases.comparison_role: Related active Detail logical contract against pw-manga--default; the retained displayed Reader session is history.
cases.observation: The candidate visibly returns to upright portrait Detail. Cover/title, author/provider/language lines and the three-line synopsis are legible. The resume strip shows chapter 34 at 12/40 with separate bookmark and trend controls. Six complete chapter rows 86 through 81 preserve leaders, dates and download buttons. The 1/8 folio and next-page control have clear bottom space. Relative hierarchy, cover bounds, action row and list spacing agree with the opened related Detail reference; no Reader overlay is present.
cases.software_evidence: Frozen actions set orientation=reverse-landscape then invoke reader back. Active state and metadata both report Detail, portrait and rotation 0; displayed_reader_session.landscape=true is retained history and does not select the active contract.
cases.accepted_scope: Visible active Detail and owner-recorded software return after manual orientation.
cases.software_limits: No sensor-follow, physical 270-degree rotation or native framebuffer/input claim. Detail bookmark chrome is allowed by the active route. The historical Reader page source is not directly inspected here.
cases.static_verdict: Related Detail contract visually supported; no independent exact orientation-return state reference passed.

limitations: Only frozen local text and the eight assigned original image paths were read. No tests, builds, application execution, probes, validation suites, hashes, SSH, SQL, image transforms or source edits were performed.

All candidates were actually opened despite their common owner-declared Reader PNG hash. Both separately assigned checkpoint/restored processed paths were actually opened despite their common source hash.
Source panel borders and bar-mark bubbles are attributed only within the opened committed processed input and owner oracle identity; missing raw-original provenance is not replaced by the oracle.
Owner pure-reader declarations use slint-software-1.17.1-shared-rgb8-fixed8-v1 and are recorded separately from manual appearance. Expected/difference PNGs were not opened.

Native candidate dimensions are 618x824. Reference physical dimensions and static desktop orientation metadata do not qualify physical native scale, native rotation, leases, e-ink effects or performance.
